name: anycable-transactional-stream-membership-8b8e
instr:
anycable-go cannot apply an ordered stream-membership delta atomically across broker ownership, session state, persistence, restoration, and Hub fan-out. Implement transitions that return a stable report of the complete committed outcome. Retries with the same operation identifier must return that report without repeating effects; empty deltas commit unchanged.

Reject duplicate, contradictory, or oversized deltas before mutation with `ErrInvalidSubscriptionTransition` from `github.com/anycable/anycable-go/broker`, exactly `errors.New("invalid subscription transition")`. Apply documented defaults to zero-valued `SubscriptionTransitionConfig` during normal construction and CLI normalization. Direct, standalone, and composed brokers must enforce the same transition limit and recovery policy.

Preserve Legacy, Memory, and NATS reference-counted ownership, including concurrent transitions sharing streams. Coordinate backend resources as one outcome and compensate partial failures. NATS must include local ownership, broadcaster subscriptions, and stream-consumer provisioning. Report successful compensation as rolled back and unresolved compensation as indeterminate, listing only uncertain streams. Reports and `SubscriptionTransitionError` from `github.com/anycable/anycable-go/common` must retain the cause and distinguish all four outcomes. `NewLegacyBroker` must still construct the legacy implementation.
